text.p: BioWhittaker Inc said Tuesday it plans to continue pursuing talks over a possible sale of the company.

BioWhittaker, which had previously announced that it had retained Alex. Brown & Sons Inc to help it explore strategic alternatives, said today it would pursue talks with several parties who have indicated interest in a possible acquisition.
It said talks thusfar have shown "sufficient interest" to warrant continuing the negotiations.
BioWhittaker did not disclose the names of parties with which it is in talks.
It said discussions are at the preliminary stage.
BioWhittaker Inc supplies products to the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries.
